channel.title: NEXT SEO24 Magazine
channel.description: SEO, content and digital marketing insights for Malaysia and across Asia — from NEXT SEO24, a Kuala Lumpur based SEO agency.

item.title: Naver vs Google: How to Win Search in Korea
item.description: Korea's search market is split between Naver and Google. A practical guide to deciding where to invest, how the two engines differ, and why winning Korea means working both.

item.title: Google's Helpful Content System in 2026, Explained
item.description: Google's Helpful Content system is now part of core ranking and operates at the site level. Learn what that means, how AI-generated content is judged, and what to do with thin or underperforming pages.

item.title: White-Hat Backlinks: What Still Moves Rankings
item.description: Links remain a top ranking signal — but only the right ones. Relevance and context beat volume, and link schemes are exactly what spam updates target. Here's how to earn authority safely.

item.title: Core Web Vitals & INP: A Practical Speed Checklist
item.description: FID is gone — INP is Google's new responsiveness metric. A practical checklist covering LCP, CLS and INP so your site earns both rankings and conversions.

item.title: Entering Southeast Asia: A Localization Playbook
item.description: SEA is Google-dominant, multilingual and WhatsApp-first. What global brands get wrong entering the region, and how to localize properly using Kuala Lumpur as a hub.

item.title: Marketing an Online Sports Game App: ASO + SEO
item.description: How to get an online sports game app discovered — App Store Optimization, web SEO and localized content that drive real installs across Korea, Japan and Southeast Asia.

item.title: How Long Does SEO Take to Work? A Realistic Timeline
item.description: Honest answer: meaningful SEO results typically take 3-6 months, with compounding gains beyond that. Learn what drives the timeline and how to set realistic expectations.

item.title: How Much Does SEO Cost in Malaysia? 2026 Pricing Guide
item.description: SEO pricing in Malaysia ranges from RM 800 to RM 8,000+ per month. Learn what drives the cost, how retainer vs project models compare, and how to evaluate any quote fairly.

item.title: SEO vs SEM (Google Ads): Which Should You Invest In?
item.description: SEO earns compounding organic traffic; Google Ads buys instant clicks. Compare trade-offs, see when each wins, and why most businesses benefit from running both.
